payload.core_mechanism_summary: Mutual recursion: F(n) = n - M(F(n-1)), M(n) = n - F(M(n-1)), base cases F(0)=1, M(0)=0.
payload.rationale: Solution is pure mutual recursion without any search or enumeration. No candidate subtype truly matches; backtracking is the least distant but no backtracking occurs. Forced pick due to candidate constraints.
